acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick offers three products: the AI Video Platform for marketing, L&D and customer teams; Flipick LMS, an AI skills-development platform; and PowerPoint to SCORM, which converts existing decks into SCORM-ready eLearning courses.
Variable Video Production turns one master film into hundreds or thousands of personalised variants, rendered from your data so every viewer gets a version that fits them.
It converts PowerPoint, PDF or Word source material into fully animated, narrated and assessed SCORM-ready courses in approximately 15 days, with every element derived from your source documents.
Flipick uses transparent credit-based pricing: 1 credit = ₹1 (or $0.01 in USD). There are no seats and no subscriptions. The AI video base rate is 3,300 credits per finished minute.
